requirements.text: An online system for booking study rooms, allowing students to select dates and times while viewing availability.
An online functionality for managing book loans, including borrowing, returning, and renewing books to eliminate in-person queues.
A reminder system that sends notifications via email or phone before due dates for borrowed items and potential fines.
A straightforward online book return process that confirms the return and updates the student’s account immediately, along with a confirmation message.
A clear display of outstanding fines on student accounts, with reminders before fines are applied to avoid unexpected charges.
The system must integrate well with existing library systems to ensure a seamless experience.
